title: Cooler fall nights mean it is time for the extra blanket
dek: The last day of September is a good time to pull out the heavier blanket and make the bedroom ready for fall.
body: If you are awake at this hour, you may have noticed the air feels a little different now. Late September nights have started to cool down, and a thin summer sheet may no longer feel like enough by the early morning.

A small ritual can help with this change. Take the heavier blanket out of the closet, give it a wash so it smells fresh, and fold it at the foot of the bed. That way you can pull it up in the middle of the night without having to get up and look for it.

It also helps to check the little things. Make sure the window closes easily, put a pair of socks near the bed, and keep a glass of water on the nightstand, since the air can feel drier once the heater starts running.

In many places the seasons change slowly, so these small signals matter. A warmer blanket, a cup of something hot in the evening, and an earlier sunset are all reminders that the year is turning. Today is also National Hot Mulled Cider Day, which seems like perfect timing.
If you are chilly right now, grab a second blanket instead of adjusting the thermostat. Your body will settle faster, and you can make the full switch to fall bedding this weekend.
